name: pomodoro
description: A pomodoro timer on the prompt's hint line whose break lands while Claude works, with buttons beside it, a history and a report: /pomodoro start

focusMinutes.title: Focus minutes
focusMinutes.description: How long a focus round runs

breakMinutes.title: Break minutes
breakMinutes.description: How long the break after a focus round runs

longBreakMinutes.title: Long break minutes
longBreakMinutes.description: How long the break after the last round of a set runs

rounds.title: Rounds
rounds.description: How many focus rounds make a set, the long break after its last

focusStart.title: Focus starts
focusStart.description: After a break: prompt (waits for your next prompt) or auto (starts the round at once)

breakStart.title: Break starts
breakStart.description: After a focus round: claude (waits up to five minutes for Claude to start working) or auto (starts the break at once)

dailyGoal.title: Daily goal
dailyGoal.description: Focus rounds a day you aim for; 0 for none

hintStyle.title: Hint style
hintStyle.description: How the hint line shows the set: full (2/4), dots (●●○○) or minimal

controls.title: Control row
controls.description: The timer's row of buttons where there is a pointer (the fullscreen terminal, the desktop app): always, running (only while a pomodoro is on) or off

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: How loud the sounds play, 0 to 100

voice.title: Spoken announcements
voice.description: Says each phase change aloud as well, with the system voice

openPomodoro.title: Open Pomodoro files
openPomodoro.description: Keeps ~/.pomodoro/current and ~/.pomodoro/history as openpomodoro-cli does, and picks up a pomodoro it starts

scriptHooks.title: Hook scripts
scriptHooks.description: Runs ~/.pomodoro/hooks/start, stop and break as phases change, as openpomodoro-cli does

modelTools.title: Tools for Claude
modelTools.description: Lets Claude read your pomodoro stats and act on the timer when you ask it to
